answer_1.quote: Recent years have witnessed a trend moving from sentence-level neural machine translation (Sen-NMT) to its document-level counterpart (Doc-NMT).

answer_2.quote: we use BLEU to measure the general translation quality... document-level BLEU... we introduce gendered pronoun F1... and employ accuracy on contrastive test sets

answer_4.quote: Finally, we conduct human evaluation to verify the performance delivered by zero-shot transfer. We work on En-De, Europarl-7, where we sample 50 source documents from the test set, and translate them into the target language using the corresponding models and decoding techniques. The translated documents are presented to bilingual human raters who are native in the non-English locale.
answer_4.guideline: The raters assign a score in a 0-6 scale to every sentence-translation pair in the document, where 0 and 6 mean nonsense and perfect translations, respectively.
